description_en: Gönpa Gang is situated on a slope across the Kali Gandaki from Chhusang (Tshug). Early visitors describe the precarious crossing of the fast-running river. A few years ago, a suspension bridge was built thus making a visit to Gönpa Gang easily possible throughout the year. Following the steep ascent to the monastery complex one enters a small courtyard with the residential building on the left and the monastery to the right. A small, recently built entry room leads to the entrance hall which features murals depicting the Life of Sakyamuni, the Life of Padmasambhava and the Wheel of Life.The main door opens to an imposing assembly hall with the large clay statue of Maitreya and his massive throne housed in the apse to the west. Maitreya rises through two storeys with a lantern above providing natural light. Murals cover the entire wall area displaying an extensive iconographic program. Unfortunately, caused by rising damp and severe water leaks from the damaged roof, many murals are damaged and some sections have been lost completely.The large first floor room showcases additional murals and provides a generous view of the assembly hall below. The former reception room is located above the entrance hall. Through a small opening another room can be reached that provides a frontal view of Maitreya's head.An extension to the south is a later addition built in stone.Gönpa Gang's history is well documented. Following his younger brother's death Künzang Longyang returned from Tibet and begann the planning and fund raising for the convent. Many details relating to the 12-year construction period can be found in the founder's biography. Not long after the completion of the monastery Künzang Longyang died
description_ne: मुस्ताङको यस गङ्ग गुम्बालाई कुन्साङ् लोङ्ग्याङ्गले सन् १६८४ देखि १६९६ सम्ममा बनाएका हुन् ।छुसाङ्तर्फबाट कालीगण्डकीको पारिपट्टि रहेको ठाडो भीरमाथि गङ्ग गुम्बा रहेको छ । सुरुका दिनमा यहाँ पुगेकाहरूले कालीगण्डकी नदीको प्रवाह छिचोल्नु पर्दाको कठिनाइका बारेमा आफ्ना अनुभवहरू लेखेका छन् । केही वर्ष अगाडी झोलुङ्गे पुल बनेपछि भने वर्षैभरि गङ्ग गुम्बा पुग्न सजिलो भएको छ । ठाडो उकालो चढेर पुगिने गुम्बाभित्र एउटा सानो चोक रहेको छ । बायाँपट्टी आवासीय भवन रहेको छ भने दायाँपट्टी गुम्बा रहेको छ । नयाँ बनाइएको एउटा कोठाबाट भित्र प्रवेश गर्दा एउटा हल देखिन्छ । यहाँ शाक्यमुनि बुद्ध र गुरु पद्मसम्भवको जीवनी लगायतका भित्तेचित्रहरू देखिन्छ ।मूल ढोकाबाट भित्र एउटा ठूलो सभाकक्ष बनाइएको छ । यहाँ मैत्रेय बोधिसत्त्वको माटोको ठूलो मूर्ति राखिएको छ भने उनको ठूलो आसन पश्चिमपट्टि राखिएको छ । मैत्रेयको मूर्ति दुई तल्ला अग्लो छ जसको माथि बत्ती राखिएको छ । विस्तारित रूपमा कोरिएका भित्तेचित्रहरू भित्ताभरि नै फैलिएका छन् । तर ओस र छानाबाट चुहिएको पानीका कारण धेरै भित्तेचित्रहरू बिग्रिएका छन् भने केहि अंश पूर्ण रूपमा हराइसकेका छन् ।निक्कै फैलिएको माथिल्लो तल्लामा पनि थुप्रै भित्तेचित्रहरू कोरिएका छन् । यहाँबाट तलको सभाकक्ष पूरै देखिन्छ । सानो ढोकाबाट अर्को कोठामा पुगिन्छ जहाँबाट मैत्रेयको शिरलाई अगाडिबाट देखिन्छ ।ढुंगाबाट बनाइएको गुम्बाको दक्षिणतिरको अंश भने पछि थपिएको हो ।गुम्बाको इतिहास राम्रोसंग अभिलेखीकरण गरिएको छ । आफ्नो भाइको मृत्यु पछि कुन्साङ् लोङ्ग्याङ्ग तिब्बतबाट फर्के र गुम्बाको निर्माणका लागि योजना बनाइ आवश्यक रकम जुटाउन थाले । गुम्बाको १२ वर्षे निर्माण अवधिका थुप्रै कुराहरू विस्तृत रूपमा उनको जीवनीमा समेटिएको छ । गुम्बा बनाउन सकिएको केही समय पछि नै कुन्साङ् लोङ्ग्याङ्गको निधन भएको थियो ।

historical_events.event_description: Gönpa Gang (dgon pa sgang), its full original name being Göngang Künzang Chöling (dgon sgang kun bzang chos gling) was built by Künzang Longyang (kun bzang klong yangs; 1644–1696) in memory of his brother between 1684 and 1695. (see Harrison, Luczanits, Ramble 2018: 55).On the founder and his teacher, Orgyen Pelzang (o rgyan dpal bzang; 1617–1677) see Ehrhard 2013a: 207–10, and Harrison, Luczanits, Ramble 2018: 101–116. Details about the construction are revealed in the founder’s autobiography summarised by Ramble.
The autobiography of Künzang Longyang recounting the author's decicion to found Künzang Chöling (Gönpa Gang)
